description: This file defines classes related to Bluetooth data record handling, including a Buffer class and various DataRecord classes supporting different byte orders. It provides mechanisms for managing byte buffers, converting data to hex strings, and reading/writing data with endian-awareness.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A byte buffer class derived from std::basic_string<uint8_t> with a method to convert its contents to a hex string.

classes.name: DataRecord
classes.description: A byte buffer wrapper supporting read/write operations with endian-neutral handling, including methods for pushing and popping data types.

classes.name: DataRecordBE
classes.description: Endian-big (network byte order) version of DataRecord, supporting multi-byte integer push/pop with big-endian encoding.

classes.name: DataRecordLE
classes.description: Endian-little version of DataRecord, supporting multi-byte integer push/pop with little-endian encoding.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the buffer contents to a hex string representation.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns new data to the buffer, replacing its contents.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer offsets and size indicators.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Sets the write offset to a specific position.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write offset by a specified length.

methods.name: Rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the read offset to a specific position.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips forward in the read offset by a specified length.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Fills a section of the buffer with a specific byte value.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes various data types into the buffer, including raw bytes, strings, booleans, and other DataRecords.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Extracts data from the buffer into variables or objects, supporting strings, buffers, and data records.
